key_insight: MIMIC-Note-Extract converts free-text discharge summaries into reusable structured data, expanding access to clinical information missing from existing MIMIC tables.
clinical_relevance: Structured histories, allergies, and diagnostic findings could support clinical AI research while reducing repeated data-curation work.
method: Extract 16 sections from 300,720 MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries.
Combine deterministic parsing with schema-guided large language model generation.
Use the resulting tables to build a clinical decision-making benchmark for LLM agents.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports physician-validated extraction accuracy above 92% across sections, 10 times more patient-history entries, and medication histories covering more than twice as many admissions as related structured MIMIC tables.
watch_item: Extraction accuracy does not establish clinical decision-making safety; validation sample details and performance outside MIMIC are not provided in the abstract.
paper_title: MIMIC-Note-Extract: A Large-Scale Structured Dataset Extracted from MIMIC-IV-Note Discharge Summaries
